notes.title: The demo of CABALL: sunset hour is available for review!
notes.content:
The demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3319370/CABALL_sunset_hour/?beta=0]CABALL: sunset hour[/url] is available for review!

Veronica tries to return to her old life and forget about the encounter with mystical creatures. But everything changes when her only amulet ceases to protect her.

In passers-by, dark corners and her own reflection, she sees creepy creatures and hears tantalizing whispers of an approaching holiday.

Veronica finds herself in the epicenter of the Caballs games and is forced to become a full participant.
----------------------------------------
In the demo version of the game half of one of the routes is available.
CABALL: sunset hour - is a direct story sequel to CABALL and it is recommended that you familiarize yourself with the main story.
_________
Would love feedback and support to make this story even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633408/f17507e3fac39e3add684ca082d042f2c3256857.png[/img]

notes.title: The continuation of the CABALL to be!
notes.content:
[b]CABALL: sunset hour[/b] - this is a storyline continuation of the "Shackles of the Soul" route. This is a completely new story, telling the events after the main story.

This is a separate game because I wanted to change a lot of things in the “insides” of the game. The first experience showed the mistakes made (gallery, for example). Now everything will be more convenient, prettier and most importantly I jumped into the devil romance!

The characters will show other sides of their personalities, but will it be pleasant? Who knows. Veronica has no way back.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3319370/CABALL_sunset_hour/?beta=0]CABALL: sunset hour[/url]

notes.title: CABALL discount in honor of the upcoming holiday!
notes.content:
For this mystery story, I'm cooking up *something* else I'll be able to tell you about soon. In the meantime, happy Halloween🖤🤍
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633408/d25cd3e5cb8fc80e0861f6dc5ac6efdd396b03b3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: CABALL is now available!
notes.content:
All preparations are complete and I can announce with peace of mind: [b]CABALL is out and available to read![/b].

Compared to the demo version, the story has grown considerably. In the demo there were about 8k words. The release version has over 40k words! A bit more than originally planned, but now each key character has time to show themselves from all sides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633408/4b5224bd28710ad0ab843fab4f6396913a7eb685.jpg[/img]

I would be immensely happy with the feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307780/CABALL/
